messages.subject: Re: is there a way to put the label on the same row of the input control (like textbox, select, etc.)?
parts:
Here is what I did.

At where you place this:
                        textInput("my_input", "Mode:", value = "1"),

use this instead:

HTML("<table>"),
HTML("<tr><td class='leftcolumn'>Mode:</td><td>"),
textInput("my_input", "", value = "1"),
HTML("</td></tr>"),
HTML("</table>"),
